Hotel chain/brand name ('Pullman Hotels and Resorts')

Structured FAQ question headings (e.g., 'What kind of breakfast is served at...?')

Reviewer name in review cards (e.g., 'Sim')
Reviewer country in review cards (e.g., 'United States')

Hotel/property names in homepage recommendation cards (e.g., 'Hotel Allegro Einsiedeln', 'Château Gütsch')
